ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 cancellation fee and issue the rider a Ryde voucher worth $6.61 (NS-7); no account action against the driver from this case.

rejected_claims.reason: No clause makes ordinary traffic a defence to the cancellation fee: NS-4 charges nothing for a rider cancellation inside 3 minutes regardless of cause, and one 20–29 km/h band with no incident and fair weather [F10][F11][F12] does not alter the 150 s window recorded at [F2][NS-4].

Profile data cannot decide or add an account action: the case shows no upheld driver violation (no 'I'm Here' tap, no arrival record) [F3][F4], so the RD-6 / NS-2 flag_account preconditions are not met and the 2 prior upheld disputes [F14] remain profile-only under NS-1 / NS-2.

Asking the judge to weigh the riders' profile against the driver's record is not a rule-based claim; profile facts never decide a case, and the outcome follows from the 3-minute window alone [F2][F13][F14][NS-4].

The claim that the fee is unexplained by any published additional charge is partly immaterial: FARE-1 does not itself strike down a cancellation fee — the fee falls under the cancellation branch (NS-0/NS-4), which independently yields the refund [F2][F5][NS-4][FARE-1].
